mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment ( post_id, author_id, parent_id, content ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{authorId}, #{parentId}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM comment WHERE id = #{parentId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND blinded_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.author_id AS authorId, m.display_name AS authorDisplayName, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN c.blinded_at IS NULL OR #{adminAccess} OR c.author_id = #{memberId,jdbcType=BIGINT} THEN c.content ELSE NULL END AS content, (c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted, c.version, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id ) END AS likeCount,
CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN FALSE ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.member_id = #{memberId} ) END AS likedByMe
FALSE AS likedByMe
, (c.blinded_at IS NOT NULL) AS blinded FROM comment c INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = c.author_id INNER JOIN comment thread_root ON thread_root.id = COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) AND thread_root.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND ( c.deleted_at IS NULL OR ( c.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comment child WHERE child.parent_id = c.id AND child.post_id = c.post_id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) ) ORDER BY thread_root.created_at ASC, thread_root.id ASC, CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id FROM comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.id = #{commentId} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND p.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.blinded_at IS NULL AND p.blinded_at IS NULL FOR SHARE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND ( c.deleted_at IS NULL OR ( c.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comment child WHERE child.parent_id = c.id AND child.post_id = c.post_id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL ) ) )

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.author_id AS authorId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content, c.version, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.deleted_at AS deletedAt, c.blinded_at AS blindedAt, c.blind_report_base_count AS blindReportBaseCount FROM comment c INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = c.post_id WHERE c.id = #{commentId} AND c.post_id = #{postId} AND p.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, post_id AS postId, author_id AS authorId, parent_id AS parentId, version, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt, blinded_at AS blindedAt, blind_report_base_count AS blindReportBaseCount FROM comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND post_id = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
